```ts
import { defineConfig } from 'vite';
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';
import path from 'path';

  plugins: [react()],
  resolve: {
    alias: {
      "@": path.resolve(__dirname, "src"),
      '@inscribe/shared': path.resolve(__dirname, '../../packages/shared/src/index.ts'),

    },
  },
  server: {
    port: 5173,
  },
  base: './',
  build: {
    outDir: 'dist/renderer',
  },
});
```

```json
{
    "name": "inscribe",
    "version": "0.1.0",
    "description": "Desktop GUI application that safely applies AI-generated code into an existing codebase",
    "private": true,
    "workspaces": [
        "apps/*",
        "packages/*"
    ],
    "scripts": {
        "build": "npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/engine && npm run build -w apps/desktop",
        "test:engine": "npm run test -w packages/engine",
        "dev:engine": "npm run dev -w packages/engine",
        "dev:desktop": "concurrently -k \"npm -w packages/shared run dev:build\" \"npm -w packages/engine run dev:build\" \"npm -w apps/desktop run dev\""
    },
    "devDependencies": {
        "concurrently": "^8.2.2",
        "typescript": "^5.3.3"
    }
}
```
